releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.99 adds permanent Delete to Files > Search multi-select. Select one file or multiple files and use Delete; a confirmation appears before the files are physically removed from phone storage. After deletion the saved file index and any category assignment are cleaned so deleted items do not return after Reload. The path-based selection/delete flow is shared by Documents, Photos/Images and Videos, while Add to Category and the circular My Categories design remain unchanged.
